card.name: Amounts just before a currency unit
card.fires_on: Numbers or quantity words (a digit, thousand, every, a, few, gold) that come right before a currency name such as crowns, livres, thalers, guilder, dollars or ore. Mostly in historical or money-related prose.

modes.label: Digits in a sum
modes.description: A digit or the end of a number in a sum of money, with the currency named next.

modes.label: Quantity word before money
modes.description: A word like every, a, few or thousand stands where a currency unit is expected next.
modes.example: for<< every>> guilder for which it gives credit in

modes.label: Denomination on coins or stamps
modes.description: A digit in a coin, note or stamp value, followed by a currency.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict a currency name next, such as kron, franc, zł or mark.
card.plain: It fires on a number or amount word when the next word is likely to be a currency like crowns, francs or guilders.
